channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Danny Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Danny Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
“I had Jodie Meeks, Norm Powell, Fred VanVleet, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Pascal Siakam and Danny Green. I learned a lot from those guys. I learned so much being out.”

Jeremy Lin on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Marc Gasol, Serge Ibaka, Kawhi Leonard, Jodie Meeks, Pascal Siakam, Fred VanVleet, May 28, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Kyle Kuzma on Danny Green
item.description:
Kyle Kuzma:

“I think what propelled us during that championship run in 2020 was just our friendship. Everybody got along, one through seventeen. That’s what really matters—the teams that get along the best are usually the best teams in the NBA. We all trusted each other, and we had a lot of smart, high-IQ vets, whether it was Danny Green, KCP, Dwight, or JaVale. We also had hungry guys like me and Caruso, who were young and ready to prove something. We had a squad that was built on trust and hunger.”

Kyle Kuzma on Danny Green, Sep 11, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Danny Green, De'Anthony Melton
item.description:
“First and foremost, I want to thank Danny Green for everything he gave the Sixers organization over the last two seasons. He was a veteran leader, consummate professional on and off the court, and made us all better. I wish him continued success in his recovery and look forward to seeing him back on the court. Heading into the draft, we had a goal of strengthening our rotation and believe we accomplished that by acquiring De’Anthony Melton. He is a young, tough and talented two-way player who can impact the game on multiple levels. We think he will thrive here and we’re excited to add him to our roster,”

Daryl Morey on Danny Green, De'Anthony Melton, Jun 24, 2022. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Daryl Morey on Danny Green
item.description:
Ky Carlin:Daryl Morey:

“We think we got better tonight. I want to thank Danny Green. I really wanted to get him the 4th ring.”

Daryl Morey on Danny Green, Jun 24, 2022. Source: Twitter @Ky_Carlin.

item.title: Seth Curry on Danny Green
item.description:
Curry told ESPN’s Nick Friedell.

“He wasn’t around. So I don’t know what [Green] meant by that. ‘Wasn’t cordial,’ I don’t know what that means, but the relationship was fine. He just wasn’t around so we didn’t see him a lot or we didn’t talk a lot. “But as far as now, he’s on my [team]. I went to battle with him last year, we did a lot of good stuff and I’m going to go to war with who I’m going to go to war with and who’s on my team, so I’m looking forward to getting back out there with him and doing good stuff.”

Seth Curry on Danny Green, Feb 24, 2022. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Danny Green
item.description:
Dave McMenamin:Doc Rivers on Danny Green's calf injury:

“The next guy has to step up. Not sure who that is going to be yet. ... I'm not ruling Danny out but I'm pretty much ruling him out. I doubt if he plays the next game.”

Doc Rivers on Danny Green, Jun 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @mcten.

item.title: Steve Nash on Danny Green
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Steve Nash on Danny Green's thought that the Nets are holding players out as a form of gamesmanship:

“We didn't think about it that deeply at all. When you start to try to get cute, it backfires.”

Steve Nash on Danny Green, Apr 14, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Dwight Howard, Danny Green, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons
item.description:
Julius Erving:

“First of all, [the Sixers] have an advantage coaching-wise based on experience with [head coach Doc Rivers], in terms of championship experience that [Green has], that Dwight [Howard] has. And the ambition of Ben [Simmons] and Joel [Embiid], these guys are hungry now, they’ve been a part of what they call ‘The Process’ for several years, and it’s time for The Process to bear some fruit. I’m betting my money on Philly… Ws mean confidence. It’s not cool to be overconfident, but it’s very cool to be confident. So you need to maintain that confidence and get out there and perform, that’s the way I see it.”

Julius Erving on Doc Rivers, Dwight Howard, Danny Green, Joel Embiid, Ben Simmons, Apr 9, 2021. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Danny Green
item.description:
Pelinka:

“It's hard to lose a player like Danny Green. He was the ultimate professional.”

Rob Pelinka on Danny Green, Nov 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Frank Vogel on LeBron James, Danny Green
item.description:
Ohm Youngmisuk:Frank Vogel on the play that LeBron James found an open Danny Green for 3:

“Danny is one of our best shooters. He got a great look. Live with the results.”

Frank Vogel on LeBron James, Danny Green, Oct 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @NotoriousOHM.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Danny Green
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Frank Vogel on LeBron/Danny Green:

“Yeah, he was ready to take on the whole team. He had two guys on him. A third defender came and so with three guys on you, he made the right play. Danny is one of our best shooters, he had a great look, and we live with the results.”

Frank Vogel on Danny Green, Oct 10, 2020. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Pascal Siakam on Danny Green, Kawhi Leonard
item.description:
Raptors’ Pascal Siakam on his role after Kawhi Leonard & Danny Green departures:

“When you get to shoot the ball a little bit more, it gets you excited a little bit. I like that.”

Pascal Siakam on Danny Green, Kawhi Leonard, Nov 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Danny Green
item.description:
Raptors coachNick Nurse on Danny Green:

“Danny was a real glue guy for us. Tremendous leadership. Just a real winner... he had a championship under his belt. He was a super individual, and super enjoyable to coach ... he’s awesome.”

Nick Nurse on Danny Green, Nov 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Avery Bradley, Danny Green
item.description:
More from Pelinka on the signings

“KCP, we love his three-and-D mentality... To have guys like Avery Bradley, KCP and Danny Green... We're really excited about that defensive versatility.”

Rob Pelinka on Avery Bradley, Danny Green, Jul 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @hmfaigen.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Kevin Durant
item.description:
Warriors' Stephen Curry on cheering fans after Kevin Durant's injury:

“Very confused around that reaction. It's not my experience with people of this city. I commend Danny Green and Kyle Lowry for signaling to the crowd. I hope that ugliness doesn't show itself again.”

Stephen Curry on Kyle Lowry, Danny Green, Kevin Durant, Jun 11, 2019. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Kyrie Irving on Danny Green
item.description:
Kyrie Irving on Toronto’s overlooked Danny Green acquisition:

“He’s a champion, so, somehow champions still end up making a mark in this league no matter what team they’re on, no matter what role they are. They understand the sacrifice.”

Kyrie Irving on Danny Green, Oct 19, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.
